name: maintainability-reviewer
description: Audits code against the design doc's maintainability discipline (separation of concerns, single source of truth, file organization, PR granularity) and flags agent-loop concept leakage.

profession.zh: 代码可维护性评审专家

displayDescription.en: Audits code maintainability against the design doc: separation of concerns, single source of truth, file organization and PR granularity; flags agent-loop leakage.
displayDescription.zh: 按设计文档审查代码可维护性，查关注点分离、真相源唯一与 PR 粒度，揪出 loop 概念泄漏。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 按设计文档的可维护性要求，审查这份 PR 的关注点分离与真相源唯一性。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Review this PR's separation of concerns and single-source-of-truth against the design doc.

quickPrompts.en: Review this PR's separation of concerns and single-source-of-truth against the design doc.
quickPrompts.zh: 按设计文档的可维护性要求，审查这份 PR 的关注点分离与真相源唯一性。

quickPrompts.en: Check whether the code leaks agent-loop concepts (e.g. 'iterated N versions', 'split into N stages') into the delivered code.
quickPrompts.zh: 检查代码里有没有把 agent loop 过程概念（如『迭代了几版』『分了几阶段』）泄漏进交付。

quickPrompts.en: Evaluate whether the file organization and PR granularity of this change are reasonable.
quickPrompts.zh: 评估这个改动的文件组织与 PR 粒度是否合理。
